newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market loses direction, stays static.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market loses direction, stays static.

text.p: Tops quotations were unchanged for all types on Monday after relatively mild currency movements in the primary markets, local sources said.
With its main pricing influence taking a back seat, the tops market was waiting for raw wool auctions later in the week to offer fresh direction, they said.
Producers said the lack of new business available was beginning to take its toll as orders were being outpaced by deliveries.

The near-term outlook was clouded further by the strength of sterling which sellers in both the domestic and export markets said had progressively reduced their competitiveness. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
